Subject: Helion Systems — Vendor onboarding kickoff & required bank/tax details

Hi Jordan / Alex,

Welcome — glad to have Helion kicking off with Redwood. I'm Marcus on the procurement team; Neha (cc'd) will own the vendor profile. To get you into our PO/payments flow we need a short set of vendor details and a few documents so Finance can activate your supplier record. Attached is our vendor intake template and ACH instructions to make this faster.

Can you please provide the following by end of week? Separately note any terms that are a hard requirement for you.

Required fields:
- Legal entity name as registered (exactly how it appears on W-9)
- Registered address (street, city, state/province, ZIP/postal code, country)
- W-9 / tax form (attach PDF)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number if non-US)
- Remit-to address (if different from registered address)
- Preferred invoice email and PO contact
- Bank account details for ACH (routing number, account number, account name) — if you prefer wire, please include wire routing and intermediary bank details
- Currency preference and any early-pay discounts you offer

Attachments included: redwood_vendor_intake_v2.pdf, ACH_instructions.pdf

PII/Compliance note: If you prefer to transmit bank account numbers via a secure DocuSign or our encrypted intake form, we can send a link.

Next steps on our side: once we have W-9 + bank info, Finance will run the vendor activation (typically 3–5 business days) and we will issue the first PO. If you have a preferred PO template/terms, please attach.

Thanks — small set of items to get you onboarded quickly. Let me know if you'd like a 20-min call to walk through.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the W-9. I'm creating your vendor profile in our ERP and have a couple clarifying items before we activate: 

1) Can you confirm the remit-to address format for our payments file (line1 / line2)? You indicated it's the same as registered, just want it in the exact block as it should appear on the remittance notice.
2) For ACH — we prefer you upload bank details via our secure DocuSign link. If you'd rather not, we'll accept an encrypted email but the DocuSign link is the fastest. Do you want me to send the link now?
3) You noted Net 30 preferred. For the initial pilot PO we can accept Net 30; for ongoing enterprise pricing we sometimes extend to Net 45 via finance approval — if you want to request Net 45 please reply with rationale/volume and I'll escalate to Karthik.
4) Do you require Redwood to include any specific PO language or invoicing references (e.g., PO number in subject, line-item breakdown)?

If you can confirm 1–3 today we'll aim to complete vendor activation by end of week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
